description: Verify that TCP in ESTABLISHED sends an ACK indicating the correct SEQ number after receiving a SYN with seq out of window (RFC 793 §3.4 p34)
approach:
[Objective]
A SYN arriving on an established connection (with OTW seq) is anomalous — DUT must reply with a corrective ACK announcing its expected SEQ. RFC 793 §3.4 mandates this for the OTW-SYN shape specifically.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN with OTW seq.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK with proper SEQ.

[Pass condition]
DUT corrective ACK observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_otw_syn_ack — no DUT ACK to OTW SYN

verdicts.Pass: DUT corrective-acked OTW SYN in EST — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_otw_syn_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW SYN
